stage0079_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$シゲル$$
「We've got a visual on the unidentified
　moving object.」

stage0079_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Send the deactivation signal.
　Force-eject the Entry Plug」

stage0079_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マヤ$$
「It's no use!
　The halt signal and eject code aren't
　being recognized!」

stage0079_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シゲル$$
「Confirmed a core-like erosion spot
　around the Entry Plug!」

stage0079_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マコト$$
「The analysis pattern is in!
　...It's blue!」

stage0079_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「As of this moment, EVA Unit-03 is written off.
　We now identify the target as the Ninth Angel」

stage0079_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マコト$$
「Unit-01 has arrived at the scene!」

stage0079_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No way... an Angel...?
　Is that an Angel...!?」

stage0079_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That's right.
　It's the target」

stage0079_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The target...? That's an EVA, isn't it...!
　No way...」

stage0079_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The target is closing in.
　You will destroy it」

stage0079_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But, you say target, but...
　Isn't $$アスカ$$ riding in it?
　$$アスカ$$'s...」

stage0079_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The Entry Plug's inserted in Unit-03!
　$$アスカ$$ really is in there!」

stage0079_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「What are you doing?
　The target is right in front of you」

stage0079_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That's right.
　Annihilate the target」

stage0079_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll fight to save $$アスカ$$...!」

stage0079_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「There's no way I can do it!
　Not with $$アスカ$$ inside it!!」

stage0079_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Erosion detected near the armor's cervical area!
　Contamination confirmed to layer 6200!」

stage0079_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$冬月$$
「An erosion type, as I thought.
　Troublesome」

stage0079_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Life support malfunction!
　Any further and the pilot's in danger!」

stage0079_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$冬月$$
「Not good!
　Cut the neural link to 28%!」

stage0079_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$冬月$$
「But, Ikari...
　At this rate the pilot will die」

stage0079_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「$$シンジ$$, why won't you fight?」

stage0079_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Because... $$アスカ$$'s in there, Father...!」

stage0079_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It doesn't matter.
　That thing is an Angel... our enemy」

stage0079_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But I can't...!
　I can't kill $$アスカ$$!」

stage0079_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Fine!
　Better than killing $$アスカ$$!」

stage0079_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It doesn't matter.
　Cut the pilot's sync with Unit-01 entirely」

stage0079_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Switch control to the Dummy System」

stage0079_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マヤ$$
「But the Dummy System still has many issues,
　and without Dr. Akagi's orders...」

stage0079_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It'll be more use than the current pilot.
　Do it!」

stage0079_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Hang on, $$アスカ$$!
　I'll save you now!」

stage0079_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$冬月$$
「What will you do, Ikari?
　The longer this drags on, the worse for us」

stage0079_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Erosion detected near the armor's cervical area!
　Contamination confirmed to layer 6200!」

stage0079_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$冬月$$
「An erosion type, as I thought.
　Troublesome」

stage0079_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Life support malfunction!
　Any further and the pilot's in danger!」

stage0079_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$冬月$$
「Not good!
　Cut the neural link to 28%!」

stage0079_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$冬月$$
「But, Ikari...
　At this rate the pilot will die」

stage0079_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Cut the pilot's sync with Unit-01 entirely」

stage0079_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Switch control to the Dummy System」

stage0079_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$マヤ$$
「But the Dummy System still has many issues,
　and without Dr. Akagi's orders...」

stage0079_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It'll be more use than the current pilot.
　Do it!」

stage0079_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What are you doing to the EVA, Father!?」

stage0079_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$不動$$
「Doing the same thing again, are we...」

stage0079_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Main control system switch complete.
　All neural circuits now linked directly
　to the Dummy System」

stage0079_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「This makes the pilot's presence unnecessary」

stage0079_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That black EVA over there looks like
　it's being eroded by an Angel...」

stage0079_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$, answer me!
　What's happening with Unit-01!?」

stage0079_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$いぶき$$
「No good!
　There's no response from Unit-01!」

stage0079_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What is going on!
　The monitor's dead and I can't get comms!!」

stage0079_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We stop both EVAs...!
　All units, begin your attack!」

stage0079_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「The second child is riding in Unit-03」

stage0079_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$タケル$$
「From the EVA the Angel's eroding,
　I sense $$アスカ$$, faint but there!」

stage0079_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... to think a wingless one would try
　to open the door to the gods...
　This truly is where myth ends」

stage0079_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you can't recall, that's fine.
　But I'm not the only one who won't allow
　the wingless to advance to a new stage」

stage0079_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... servants of the Olympian gods.
　Do your best, won't you」

stage0079_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（A day will come when you and I settle this too.
　Until then, you'd best wait）

stage0079_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What is with that guy!
　Going on and on about nonsense!」

stage0079_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Right now, deal with Mycenae and the Angel!」

stage0079_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$號$$
「What Kedora and his kind are after
　is the man-made god」

stage0079_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$渓$$
「I don't really get it, but that means Unit-01, right」

stage0079_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$凱$$
「Unit-01's lashing out at random,
　the Angel's after Unit-01 and us,
　and Mycenae's after us and Unit-01!?」

stage0079_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$タケル$$! How's $$アスカ$$ doing!?」

stage0079_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$タケル$$
「The longer this goes, the more dangerous!
　We need to get her out within 4 minutes, at least!」

stage0079_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So we gotta stop that Angel within 4 minutes!」

stage0079_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「For that, we need to handle Unit-01 and Mycenae!」

stage0079_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アルト$$
「But we're doing this!
　I won't let them touch $$アスカ$$ or $$シンジ$$!」

stage0079_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As you've heard, everyone.
　Our top priority is stopping the Angel」

stage0079_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But if Mycenae takes down Unit-01,
　$$シンジ$$'s life will be in danger.
　If possible, we'll stop Unit-01 ourselves too」

stage0079_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「I'll save you both!
　So just hang on a little longer!」

stage0079_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Commander Ikari, what will you do!?」

stage0079_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$マコト$$
「Since $c has arrived,
　even if we cut the Dummy System...」

stage0079_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If we stop Unit-01 now,
　we'll only take Mycenae's attacks.
　Continue the battle」

stage0079_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What is it!?
　What's going on!?
　Tell me, father! Father!!」

stage0079_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$赤木$$
「Now we just need to destroy the core...!」

stage0079_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Now we just need to destroy the core...!」

stage0079_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What is it, father!? What!?
　What are you doooing!?」

stage0079_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Damn it...!
　Stop...! Stop, stop, stop, stop, stop...!」

stage0079_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Stop, stop, stop, stop, stop...
　Stop, stop, stop, stop, stop... stooop...!」

stage0079_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now we just need to stop the Angel!」

stage0079_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「$c alone can't defeat the Angel.」

stage0079_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$アスカ$$'s losing consciousness!
　Let's hurry!」

stage0079_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　We're settling this in the next minute!!」

stage0079_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't think about anything else!
　Just focus on stopping the Angel!!」

stage0079_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$アスカ$$...!
　I swear... I swear I'll save you!」

stage0079_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$シンジ$$
「We're all going to eat the food Ayanami made!
　$$アスカ$$ too!!」

stage0079_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Just wait, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　I'll definitely save you!」

stage0079_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$甲児$$
「Just hang in there a little longer!
　We're giving it everything we've got!」

stage0079_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　We're saving $$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$!」

stage0079_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Those two finally became friends!
　We're getting them out no matter what!」

stage0079_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If we can't save $$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$ here,
　I won't be able to face $$トウジ$$ and the others!」

stage0079_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Rampaging EVA or Angel, I won't lose!
　I'm saving both of them, no matter what!!」

stage0079_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　The rampaging EVA and the Angel, both bloodthirsty beasts!」

stage0079_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Hang in there, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　We're going in a little rough!!」

stage0079_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$葵$$
「A rampaging EVA and an Angel!
　Can't lose a beast showdown!」

stage0079_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$葵$$
「Sorry, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　No time to be polite about this!!」

stage0079_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$シンジ$$'s fighting back inside Unit-01!
　$$アスカ$$'s fighting the Angel too!」

stage0079_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'm in too!
　I'll fight to save them both!」

stage0079_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$ are both our cute juniors!
　We're saving them, no question!」

stage0079_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hang in there, both of you!
　I'll yank that plug out in no time!!」

stage0079_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$シモン$$
「They're out for our blood!
　Can't fight this half-hearted!」

stage0079_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Grit your teeth, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　It might hurt a bit, but we'll save you fast!!」

stage0079_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　Just hang on a little longer!」

stage0079_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll save you both, I promise!
　I promise... I really promise!!」

stage0079_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アルト$$
「If something happens to a club member,
　I couldn't face $$宗介$$ or $$カレン$$!」

stage0079_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just wait, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　I'll do my duty as club president!!」

stage0079_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　Can you hear our voices!」

stage0079_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We're saving you right now!
　Don't you dare give up!!」

stage0079_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$桂$$
「The enemy's a rampaging EVA and an Angel...!
　But I can't afford to flinch!!」

stage0079_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$桂$$
「Saving kids is a grown-up's job!
　Just wait, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!!」

stage0079_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　Listen to my sooong!!」

stage0079_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't you dare give up!
　Keep your souls burning!!」

stage0079_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since words won't reach an opponent like this,
　force is the only option!」

stage0079_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　Sorry, but you'll have to bear with this a little!」

stage0079_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「Just wait, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　I'll definitely get you out of there!」

stage0079_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$n
「Then it's a feast afterward!
　$$レイ#333$$'s miso soup will be amazing!」

stage0079_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（Because... I want to feel warm with you...!）

stage0079_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（It should have happened to me instead...）

stage0079_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（So, I will save you...
　For Ikari's sake too...!）
